articles.summary: CrossMod homes combine the best of on-site and off-site built housing, complying with state and local building standards. They offer amenities typically found in site-built homes, such as garages, carports, pitched roofs, and energy-efficient features.
articles.title: What is a CrossMod® Home?

articles.summary: The main difference between manufactured and modular homes is the codes they’re built to. Manufactured homes are built to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Code, and modular homes are built to state codes, such as the International Residential Code, or IRC.
articles.title: The Difference Between Manufactured and Modular Homes
